Matrix constructors

Source: R/matrices-expr.R
matrix-builders.Rd

sym_diag(...) is SymPy's diag() (block diagonal from scalars and matrices; renamed so it does not mask base::diag()). banded(...) builds a banded matrix from a named list of diagonals, list("0" = 1, "-1" = c(2, 3)), with the size given as banded(n, d) or banded(r, c, d) or inferred. rot_givens(i, j, theta, dim) is the Givens rotation in the (i, j) plane (zero based). sym_trace(M) is the trace (renamed so it does not mask base::trace()). SparseMatrix(r, c, entries) takes list(list(i, j, value), ...) with zero based indices.

Usage

sym_diag(...)

sym_trace(M)

banded(...)

rot_givens(i, j, theta, dim = 3)

SparseMatrix(r, c = NULL, entries = NULL)

MutableSparseMatrix(r, c = NULL, entries = NULL)

ImmutableSparseMatrix(r, c = NULL, entries = NULL)

Arguments

...

Diagonal entries or blocks; for banded(), the size and the diagonals.

M

A matrix or matrix expression.

i, j

Plane indices.

theta

The angle.

dim

The dimension.

r, c

Dimensions.

entries

Nonzero entries.

Value

A matrix.

Examples

sym_diag(1, 2, 3)
#> Matrix(3, 3)
#> [1, 0, 0]
#> [0, 2, 0]
#> [0, 0, 3]
banded(3, list("0" = 1, "1" = 2))
#> Matrix(3, 3)
#> [1, 2, 0]
#> [0, 1, 2]
#> [0, 0, 1]
rot_givens(0, 1, pi/3)
#> Matrix(3, 3)
#> [0.5               , 0.866025403784439, 0]
#> [-0.866025403784439, 0.5              , 0]
#> [0                 , 0                , 1]
